independent_review.review_policy: Verify all 42 claim rows and all 74 retained source objects; this is a population-exact review, not statistical sampling.

negative_controls.purpose: reject unsupported promotion to verified primary evidence
reject missing, extra, escaping, colliding or hash-mismatched retained objects
reject CSV/JSON population or field drift
reject analyst judgment presented as publisher source text

required_circulation_wording: P03 remains pending independent review. The register contains 42 claim records and the retained source manifest contains 74 objects; implementer hash verification does not establish semantic support, publication rights, transaction evidence, bankability or release approval.
limitations: The source register contains historical absolute predecessor paths; this additive plan binds only portable repository-relative successors and does not rewrite the register.
No publication or redistribution right is inferred from public availability, an official URL, local retention or successful hash verification.
PSR-0009 is analyst judgment over six supporting official records and has no separate publisher artifact; it cannot be presented as primary-source text.
The IEC catalogue result establishes only public-catalogue status at the cutoff and does not prove that no unpublished committee draft exists.
The P2 population reproduction and IEC query log are governed outside the 74-object original/converted source-manifest scope and remain separately hash-bound.
A same-implementer preflight cannot satisfy the independent source-verification reviewer or final P03 decision requirements.
Issue #1110 remains OPEN, all programme gates remain pending and Board/lender circulation remains HOLD.
